answer: Re-attestations are stored in ledge and tundra lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 10 epochs, so holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the prism graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1452 impostors cost 691 times the honest price and take 29 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
